name: hoardless
description: Read-only Mac disk usage from the Hoardless app: storage, dev caches, unused items, growth.
long_description: Starts the MCP server that ships inside the Hoardless app for macOS. Needs Hoardless installed and opened once. The server reads your Hoardless scan and can build a cleanup preview. It has no tool that moves, trashes or deletes anything.
